rootCause: Android picker can return its local photo before foreground Firebase hydration increments the auth generation. SellLayout previously replaced its Stack by the admission gate, unmounting CaptureScreen and starting a new empty draft.
fix: Keep the exact same SDK actor occurrence stack mounted behind an opaque noninteractive and accessibility-hidden admission gate during fresh identity/generation/focus checks.
Observe actor UID/SDK changes synchronously in a per-mounted-component useSyncExternalStore observer; batched A-to-B-to-A invalidates continuity even when the original SDK user object is reused.

Reject stale capture/gallery/persistence callbacks using mount, native SDK source and local occurrence before local adoption, caching, analytics or navigation. No global pending picker recovery is added.

iosImpactReadOnly: The fully entered iOS capture overlay is outside SellLayout and is not invalidated by a same-UID foreground generation in ImmersiveOverlay.getCurrentCycle. Once the flow reaches /sell/photos-review, its Stack receives the same retention fix. No iOS overlay runtime is changed or native iOS success inferred.
limits: RNTL uses the repository iOS Jest preset but mounts the actual Android capture route and parent; this is not native Android device evidence.
Native picker, navigation stack, remote Firebase and filesystem transports are substituted; admission, auth store/listener and draft service implementations remain real.
No production deployment, account mutation, payment, shipment, store upload, device action or Git mutation was performed by this agent.
